Skinny Minis Bruschetta
By: Kevin Anderson
Published: Wednesday, September 2, 2015 - 10:46am

Ingredients




• 16 Piller's Skinny Bites Minis, halved lengthwise
• 3 ripe tomatoes, diced
• 60 ml (1/3 cup) red onion, finely chopped
• 30 ml (1 Tbs.) olive oil
• 6 basil leaves, chopped
• salt and pepper to taste
• 16 crostini toasts
• 60 ml (1/3 cup) shaved Parmesan, if desired

Preparation

1 In a medium bowl mix the tomatoes, garlic, onion, and olive oil. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Gently stir in basil leaves. 2 Arrange crostini toasts on a platter. Use a slotted spoon to evenly divide tomato mixture on each toast. 3 Top each with two halves of Minis. If desired, top with shaved Parmesan. Serve immediately.

About

With only 70 calories and 8 g of protein per pack of five sausages, Piller's Skinny Bites Minis pack a protein punch for traditional bruschetta.
